CBC 2026 asked about discussion topics but not about engagement or barriers; IDSSD covered both Arctic 3 (A3) and Biodiversity 3 (BD3); SRI's barrier list had extra options. IDSSD labels the top of its 0–4 scales "3"; because the wording matches, it is plotted as 4. The headline percentages pool Biodiversity 3 responses only (IDSSD's A3 answers are shown separately). **Small samples.** Most questions have 5–16 responses per event. Treat everything as indicative. :::
